newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sees Alitalia money as state aid.
newsitem.headline: EU sees Alitalia money as state aid.

text.p: The European Commission considers a planned cash injection to Italian flag carrier Alitalia is state aid under EU law, a Commission spokeswoman said on Friday.
"It will be considered as a state aid," Sarah Lambert told a news conference, adding that the EU executive would decide on any aid-approval conditions before the end of July.

Italy requested EU permission last year for a capital injection worth some 3.3 trillion lire ($2 billion) to rescue the debt-laden airline. It has been arguing that the injection does not amount to state subsidies because it is acting in accordance with its rights as a shareholder.
Under EU law, state aid can only be granted to companies under strict circumstances. -- Brussels newsroom: +32 2 287-6830 ($ = 1687 Italian Lire)
